review.posthog_relevance: Adds a conditional parameter to the sanitization function, allowing callers to opt-in to stripping HTML tags alongside LLM markers. This could support a broader sanitization strategy where the caller decides whether to preserve potentially useful HTML or remove it, rather than always stripping it.
